title: Health station
intro: The health station (helsestasjon) follows your child from birth to school age. The times below are guidance ("usually around"). The municipality decides the exact timing, and you normally get an invitation from them.
homeVisitNote: The health nurse usually contacts you herself.

dialog.notesPlaceholder: Something to remember for next time

footer: This overview is based on the national guideline from the Norwegian Directorate of Health for the health station, ages 0-5. Your municipality may use slightly different times. Always check the invitation from the health station.

home_visit.title: Home visit
home_visit.description: A health nurse visits your home, usually 7-10 days after birth. You talk about feeding, sleep, safety and how you are doing, and the baby is weighed.

week_4.title: 4 weeks (group consultation)
week_4.description: Talk about feeding, crying, safety, infection prevention and parents' wellbeing. In many places this is a group session with other parents.

week_6.title: 6 weeks
week_6.description: Doctor's examination and talk about feeding, development and safety. The baby is weighed and measured. The first rotavirus dose (oral) is given and you get information about vaccines.

month_3.title: 3 months
month_3.description: Talk about feeding, development and language stimulation, weighing and measuring. The baby gets vaccines.

month_4.title: 4 months (group consultation)
month_4.description: Talk about feeding and starting solid food, sleep, safety and starting daycare. No vaccines.

month_5.title: 5 months
month_5.description: Talk about feeding and solid food, development and dental health. The baby is weighed and measured and gets vaccines.

month_6.title: 6 months
month_6.description: Doctor's examination. Talk about diet and nutrition and how the baby is developing. No vaccines.

month_8.title: 8 months
month_8.description: Talk about feeding, interaction, language and starting daycare. No vaccines.

month_10.title: 10 months
month_10.description: Talk about feeding, development, sleep and safety. No vaccines.

month_12.title: 12 months (1 year)
month_12.description: Doctor's examination. Talk about diet, vitamin D, dental health and development. The child gets vaccines.

month_15.title: 15 months
month_15.description: Talk about diet, sleep, language, tooth brushing and safety. The child gets the MMR vaccine.

month_18.title: 17-18 months (group consultation)
month_18.description: Talk about development, diet, sleep and parents' wellbeing. No vaccines.

year_2.title: 2 years
year_2.description: Doctor's examination. Talk about diet, sleep, screen time and development. No vaccines.
